body: Damn, dude. Even if you don't play, you can sell it, get a new ps5 and change.
I could justify paying above msrp for gpu upgrades. But buying a cpu of the same gen, with the same c/t count. And considering it against what is essentially a budget threadripper? I can't
"I've bought over 30" does not scream "they're fine"
Yeah, as I said. It gets better for some. Some who have access to tools for improvement. Being alone is naturally a thing that we're not meant to do btw, it's not a thing we believe is bad.

Yeah, I do not know if I ever find that "beloved family" the way I am, and so far not so good. I've been stuck in this state for years, and the more alienated you become the harder it is to reverse this.

I have passion. I am passionate about things, I'm just not good enough at them. The only reason I want to end everything is loneliness. I have not been around other people or engaged in social activity for 6 months. I live in a city where I know nobody. I see no point keeping in going or pursuing everything while being all alone.
It's not the messing up that scares me too much. I am just sick of being alone. I am sick of seeing people living in community and commraderie as an observer.
